scenes.headline: How SteadySplats quiets a renderer that never sorts
scenes.sub: One sample per pixel, without the boiling
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fettle! Today: how a splat renderer that never sorts can still look steady.

scenes.text: Train the Gaussians on each ray to agree on a colour, so any one of them is already a good guess for the pixel.
scenes.say: The new idea is in training. Push every Gaussian on a ray toward one colour, so whichever gets drawn is close to right.

scenes.title: Two ways to draw a pixel

left.title: Sorted blending
left.say: The usual renderer sorts by depth and blends a slice of each Gaussian. Sorting costs time, and a flipped order pops.

right.title: Stochastic, no sort
items: Keep each fragment with its alpha
Right on average, noisy per frame
right.say: The stochastic renderer skips the sort. Each fragment survives with its alpha, and the depth test keeps one. Right on average, noisy per frame.

parts.note: the blending weight the rasteriser already has
parts.say: P of i is how often Gaussian i wins the pixel, the same weight blending uses.

parts.note: how far that Gaussian's colour is from the pixel
parts.say: This is how far its colour sits from the pixel's colour.
SteadySplats adds this variance to the training loss. Every piece is already computed, so it is cheap.

steps.say: One pixel. Without the term, it blends yellow, dark green and lilac. With it, every band is olive.
Both blend to the same colour. Only a stochastic renderer can tell them apart.
Each pixel also borrows its neighbours' samples, weighted by how likely each sample is here.
Those weights need the occluders in front. A small buffer of recent samples supplies them.
Over time, the reuse collapses to a moving average per pixel, the filter temporal anti-aliasing uses.

scenes.title: Average PSNR at one sample per pixel
scenes.note: 21 camera paths, 7 scenes, versus sorted rendering
scenes.say: On the paper's camera paths, the variance term alone adds about seven decibels. Reuse does the rest.

scenes.text: Sort-free splats do not pop, they boil. Most of the cure is a model whose Gaussians agree.

recap: Noise is colour variance along the ray
Reuse in space and time cleans the rest
scenes.say: Noise is colour variance along the ray. A loss term shrinks it, and reuse cleans up the rest.
